In detail

Buenavista was the site of a well-documented organised-crime occupation racket: a criminal network sold illegal access to roughly 28-30 vacant flats in a residential building for 2,000-3,000 euros each, causing two months of tension (December 2024-February 2025) before ringleaders were arrested and the building cleared. A serious but contained and resolved episode rather than a persistent pattern. Sources checked: El Espanol, 8 Jan 2025; El Diario/Somos Madrid, 7 Feb 2025.

This rating comes from a structured local-source assessment. This specific area was reviewed against credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — and the signals were consolidated across sources rather than taken from any single report, with the reasoning and the sources shown above. Madrid publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is Buenavista safe?

Wandroz currently rates Buenavista in Madrid as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Madrid during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Madrid at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Madrid publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Buenavista safe at night?

At night, Buenavista is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Madrid. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Buenavista a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Buenavista's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Madrid) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Not an official government crime feed — Buenavista's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used).
